pipeline: Direction A: PROVE code-as-verifier on FOLIO-204
description: LLM generates Python verify(answer) functions; execution replaces FOL MAX-SAT. If exactly 1 candidate passes -> adopt; else fallback to SC majority vote.

key_findings.code_gen_success: 31/204 (15.2%) - Qwen2.5-7B struggles to generate valid verify() functions for most FOLIO problems
key_findings.conclusive_verification: 16/204 (7.8%) - only half of successfully generated code produces exactly 1 passing candidate
key_findings.conclusive_accuracy: 8/16 (50%) - when conclusive, PROVE is no better than random among 3 candidates
key_findings.prove_hurts: PROVE+fallback (71.6%) < SC baseline (73.5%) - conclusive-but-wrong cases override correct SC votes, net negative
key_findings.sc_this_run_vs_ref: SC this run (73.5%) vs SC exp035 ref (77.0%) - slight variance across runs
